sn55.2:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.2:2.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti
sn55.2:2.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn55.2:2.6: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akkhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.2:2.7: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
sn55.2:3.2: idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā
